title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for fringe spacing must be provided.

title: Interference Pattern Sketch
description: Important Criteria: A rough graph of the intensity distribution in the focal plane must be included.

title: Effect of Slit Separation
description: Important Criteria: The explanation of how increasing slit separation affects fringe density must be clear.

title: Effect of Source Size
description: Important Criteria: The explanation of how increasing the source size affects the contrast of the pattern must be provided.

title: Graph for (b)
description: Optional Criteria: A second graph illustrating the effect of moving the slits further apart should be included.

title: Graph for (c)
description: Optional Criteria: A third graph showing the effect of increasing the size of the source should be included.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing factors or incorrect signs in the fringe spacing equation will result in a deduction.
